name: SearchAlertContactGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert contact group
parameters.name: contact_group_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. Default value: `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert contact
parameters.name: contact_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert contact. You can call the SearchAlertContact operation to query the contact IDs. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130703.html
parameters.help_zh: 报警联系人ID。可调用SearchAlertContact接口来查询联系人ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130703.html
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert contact group. You can query multiple alert contact groups at a time. Separate multiple group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 报警联系人分组ID。可以同时查询多个联系人分组ID，联系人分组ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: contact_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return all alert contacts in the queried alert contact group. By default, not all alert contacts are returned
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回联系人分组中包含的所有联系人。默认不返回所有联系人
